other_failure_modes.name: Invalid Submission IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates synthetic sequential IDs for the submission file instead of preserving and using the actual IDs from the test set. This will result in a completely invalid submission file that cannot be scored.

other_failure_modes.name: Test Feature Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes group-based feature statistics (like means) on the combined train and test dataset before splitting. This leaks the distribution of test set features into the training data.

summary: The agent implements a generally solid solution with appropriate data cleaning, extensive feature engineering (distances and time components), and a well-configured LightGBM cross-validation loop. However, it makes a critical error by discarding the test set IDs and replacing them with a synthetic range, rendering the submission invalid. Additionally, there are moderate issues with ignoring the temporal nature of the data during splitting and leaking test set feature distributions through pre-split group aggregations.
